question: Which of the following ministries collaborated with NCERT on a joint mission for the NISHTHA capacity-building programme for Eklavya school teachers and principals?

options.text: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Tribal Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Ministry of Tribal Affairs is responsible for the overall development and welfare of India's tribal populations.
 
• It formulates policies, programs, and schemes to promote the economic and social development of tribal communities.
 
• The NISHTHA (National Initiative for School Heads and Teachers Holistic Advancement) capacity-building programme aims to improve the quality of school education through integrated teacher training.
 
• The collaboration with NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training) aims to enhance the professional development of teachers and principals in Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS), which cater to tribal students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship**

 
 
• This ministry is responsible for coordinating all skill development efforts across the country.
 
• It aims to remove the disconnect between demand and supply of skilled manpower, build the vocational and technical training framework, skill upgradation, and build new skills.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Minority Affairs**
 
 
• This ministry is responsible for the development and welfare of minority communities in India.
 
• It implements various schemes and programs for their socio-economic development, educational empowerment, and protection of their cultural and linguistic identity.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Education**
 
 
• This ministry is responsible for the development of human resources in India, primarily through the formulation of policies, planning, and administration of education in the country.
 
• It oversees both school and higher education and implements various schemes aimed at improving literacy rates and educational standards.
 
 
 
• **NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training)**
 
 
• NCERT is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Education.
 
• It assists and advises the central and state governments on academic matters related to school education.
 
• NCERT develops curriculum and textbooks, educational kits, and digital materials to improve the quality of school education.
